final: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = a.translink GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, mix_count * 1.0 / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM mix_shares) AS above_average_share FROM mix_shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM mix_shares) ORDER BY share DESC
